facts.business: iStreet Network Limited is an ecosystem-led enterprise technology solutions company focused on enabling organisations to adopt, integrate and operationalise emerging technologies across AI, cybersecurity, cloud, data, infrastructure, observability, automation and digital transformation.

guidance_or_targets.statement: FY 2026–27 represents the Consolidation Year. The Company's focus during this phase is expected to be on strengthening the ecosystem, deepening relationships with OEMs and technology partners, broadening solution capabilities, enhancing organisational and technical capabilities.
guidance_or_targets.value: Strengthening ecosystem, deepening OEM relationships, broadening solution capabilities, enhancing capabilities

key_risks: Complexity of AI adoption for enterprises
Dependency on OEM and technology partner ecosystem
Rapid pace of innovation across AI, cloud, cybersecurity, data and infrastructure
facts.related_party_note: During the year, the non-executive directors of the Company had no pecuniary relationship or transactions with the Company.
